audio_seconds_basis: exact wav header value (frames / sample rate) as recorded by the three parent receipts, re-verified here against the files on disk

contacts.audio: wav bytes re-hashed and wav headers read for duration; no decoding beyond the container header

flight_split_identity_hash_convention: data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6> -- the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and an exposure row for a FlightRuntime flight of this roster must carry
pairing: every one of these 4,000 rows carries a sealed official-protocol output under the compact registry, produced by the three runs named in population.sources; A2T-ORG-1 is paired against those bytes and re-flies nothing on the baseline side

population.rule: each parent's own released population under the paper code's loader rule (the first recording the released loader resolves in every query_* directory; on tier 7 the FIRST user turn), sampled uniformly without replacement at 500 per tier with seed 20260803

selection.algorithm: merge of the three parent receipts' items after verifying each parent's committed SHA-256 and both of its identity hashes, then sort by sample_id; the three id sets are pairwise disjoint by tier
selection.rule: no new draw: the set-union of the three sealed official-population rosters, id for id

split_identity_hash_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>, UTF-8, no trailing newline) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention
strata_basis: tier is carried per item. Domain is NOT: it is the domain column of each tier's released manifest, recorded here as counts exactly as the three parent receipts record it, and resolved per sample at ANALYSIS time from the same manifests. Keeping it out of the item rows keeps this receipt's item shape identical to its parents' and keeps a gold-adjacent label out of the file the flight entry point reads to build its samples
